mechanism_claims.claim_text: 17BIPHE2 is supported as a membrane-active antimicrobial: flow-cytometry dye entry/depolarization context and TEM observations support bacterial membrane permeabilization/damage.

mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA binding is framed as a possible part of killing, not the sole mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Local source text supports 17BIPHE2 stability to several proteases, with trypsin cleavage noted as an exception in the supplement.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Stability evidence is recorded as a pharmacological property, not as a bacterial killing mechanism.
